basic_info.description: Truly inspiring ARCHITECTURAL design, impressive exterior and interior size and a TRANQUIL location in the HISTORIC Lone Mountain neighborhood are all yours here at 286 Willard North St. This luxurious TWO-LEVEL very HOUSE-LIKE condo was constructed along with 288 Willard North St. in 2004 by a team of very skilled local craftsmen. The gorgeous OPEN CONCEPT bldg. was designed on over FIFTY-FIVE FEET of frontage resulting in AMAZING NATURAL light. Now, after 20 years, both of these condominiums are on the OPEN MARKET for the very first time and available individually or for the BEST PRICING, purchased together. With over 1600 SQ. FT., the lovely 286 W.N. GARDEN HOME offers THREE bedrooms w/ TWO w/ En-suite DESIGNER bathrooms. Amenities include: Chefs kitchen w/ 6 BURNER RANGE, Sub-Zero, Custom Cabs, GRANITE counters, REFINISHED hardwood floors, Gas Frplc, NEW interior paint, 2-paned windows, recessed ceiling & lights, private patio w/ lovely garden and 1 car garage. A MUST-SEE home!
